news_analysis.headline_hook: Nifty trimmed losses to 91 points, yet 432 stocks hit 52-week lows: why your direct equity portfolio is bleeding worse than the headline.
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: During midday trade, the Nifty trimmed early session losses to down 91 points, while broad-market selling pushed 432 stocks to their 52-week lows.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Assuming that a modest decline in the headline benchmark index means individual mid-cap and small-cap holdings are equally stable.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Headline indices like the Nifty are market-cap weighted and can be cushioned by a few large-cap heavyweights, obscuring widespread weakness and liquidity drops across the broader market.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Assess portfolio health by checking broad-market breadth indicators and individual stock support levels rather than relying solely on headline index movements.

deck.caption:
Is your stock portfolio taking a beating even when Nifty looks fine? By noon today, Nifty trimmed its loss to just 91 points, but 432 stocks crashed to their 52-week lows.

Here is what you need to know:
• Why giant companies mask broad market weakness
• How 432 stocks hit 1-year lows while Nifty recovered
• How to check your actual portfolio safety today

Save this post to stay sharp on market movements! Do you check broad market indicators before buying, or do you only look at the Nifty index?

#Nifty50 #IndianStockMarket #ShareMarketIndia #InvestingTips #MarketDebunk
